content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: How Fees Work ## slug: events-feature-how-fees-work ## seoTitle: How Fees Work ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (Limitation) Do not use the Virtual Terminal to process a Transaction that includes Fees (Payment Processing or Tax). Fees are not supported by the Virtual Terminal. ::: ## Functionality * Event Organizers can create a {{variable.Object_Fee}} record to store tax and payment processing fee details and assign the {{variable.Object_Fee}} to an {{variable.Object_Event}}. When a {{variable.Object_Fee}} is assigned to an {{variable.Object_Event}}, it will be added to the total amount due. * Only one {{variable.Object_Fee}} can be designated as the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} at a time. * The Tabbed, Full-Width, Simple, and Dynamic user interfaces support {{variable.Object_Fee}}s. * The {{variable.Product_Payments}} app now includes the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} and {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxExempt}} fields in the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}/{{variable.Object_Transaction}} processing. * {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = "Donation," will automatically be marked as {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxExempt}} and excluded from tax calculations, whether calculated at checkout or tax-inclusive. If an Event Organizer updates the {{variable.Object_Fee}} record’s {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} or {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} values, the corresponding values on the related {{variable.Object_Event}} ({{variable.Field_Event_TaxFeeCalculatType}}) and {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ({{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxAmount}} and {{variable.Field_EventItem_PriceWithTax}}) records will be updated automatically. Values on existing {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s and other post-registration or {{variable.Object_Attendee}}-specific records will not be changed. Three new classes were added to sync the updated {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} and {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} values to all {{variable.Object_Event}}s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s, and {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}s that use that {{variable.Object_Fee}} record. * **TaxFeeSyncBatch:** Batch class to query all active {{variable.Object_Event}}s and update the tax fields. * **Event_RecalculateTaxFieldsOnChild:** Trigger handler will update the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s and {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}s after the {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} lookup is updated. * **Tax_RecalculateRelatedRecords:** Trigger handler will update the {{variable.Object_Event}}s, {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s, and {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}s after the {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} and/or {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} are updated. ## Logic The fields below are populated using the following logic: * {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFeeCalculatType}} = {{variable.Object_Fee}} {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} * {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxAmount}} = {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} * {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxRate}} * {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_EventItem_PriceWithTax}} = {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} + {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxAmount}} * If the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxExempt}} = “True” (checked), then the {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxRate}} will be “0”, the {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxAmount}} will be “0”, and the {{variable.Field_EventItem_PriceWithTax}} will be the same as the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}}. * {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSessi_TaxAmount}} = {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_TaxRate}} * {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_Price}} * {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSess_PriceWiTax}} = {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_Price}} + {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSessi_TaxAmount}} * {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_TaxRate}} = {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} * If the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field is populated when an {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} is created, the new {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}’s fields will also be populated. * If the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field is updated later, the new {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} fields will also be updated. The Tax calculation logic was updated to include {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}}s that are not marked as tax-exempt. If an {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} is paid and has a {{variable.Field_EventItemSessi_TaxAmount}}, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}’s {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} due will include the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}}, {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxAmount}}, {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSession_Price}}, and the {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} {{variable.Field_EventItemSessi_TaxAmount}}. ## Credit Card Payment Methods This following only applies when a credit card is the selected {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. * Not yet supported for PayLater and {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}. * The minimum {{variable.Object_Fee}} value is 0.01%. * The {{variable.Object_Fee}}, if designated, applies to ALL {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s. * The {{variable.Object_Fee}}, if designated, is mandatory. There is no option for the customer to opt out. ## Event Object ### Payment Processing Fee :::(Warning) (Limitation) Payment processing {{variable.Object_Fee}}s cannot be applied to ACH Payment Methods. This feature will be available in the future. ::: * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} can be changed for each {{variable.Object_Event}}. * Users who can edit the {{variable.Object_Event}} record can also edit the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} field. If a user does not have access to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} field, the field will be populated when a new {{variable.Object_Event}} is created if a {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} has been defined. ## Fee Object ### Tax Display Setting * The {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} field determines how taxes are displayed and calculated for an {{variable.Object_Event}}. To turn on tax-inclusive pricing, first set the {{variable.Object_Fee}} record's {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = "Tax" and then select a value for {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}}. The picklist values are as follows. * "Tax-Inclusive Pricing” - The advertised price will include tax. * "Calculated at Checkout” – The tax will not be visible until the final payment screen. * Please note that taxes are always displayed separately on the final payment screen. ### Type The {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} field’s picklist options are “Payment Processing Fee” and “Tax.” * This field distinguishes between tax fees and payment processing fees. Each type has a corresponding lookup field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object and different functionality. * The {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} field uses the same permissions as the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} field. * Only one {{variable.Object_Fee}} of {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Payment Processing Fee” can be marked as default. * Only one {{variable.Object_Fee}} of {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” can be marked as default. When a user creates or edits an {{variable.Object_Event}} with the default {{variable.Object_Fee}}’s {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} set to “Tax”, then the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s new {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field will be populated with the default tax fee. Changes to an {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} will be reflected on all {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s’ prices and totals. Changes to a {{variable.Object_Fee}} record associated with an {{variable.Object_Event}} will be reflected on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage when the {{variable.Object_Event}} record is updated. ## Company Info Object Customers can add an Employer Identification Number ({{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}}) or registration number ({{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_RegistNumber}}) to their {{variable.Object_CompanyInfo}} record. The {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}} or {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_RegistNumber}} will be visible below the company’s address on the DocumentLink {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. The following logic explains when each number is used. * The {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}} will be listed on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} if the related {{variable.Object_CompanyInfo}} record’s {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}} field or both {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}} and {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_RegistNumber}} fields have a value. * The {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_RegistNumber}} will be displayed when only the {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_RegistNumber}} field has a value. The {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}} field must be blank. "EIN" is the {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_EIN}} field’s default label on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. Customers can use the Data Dictionary to override the "EIN" label. For example, Australian customers might change the label to "ABN" instead. ## Invoice Object The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record has a new field called {{variable.Field_Invoice_DynamicFeeName}}. The field is populated when an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} related to an {{variable.Object_Event}} with an associated tax {{variable.Object_Fee}} is created or updated. The field’s value will then be used in DocumentLink’s Invoice to override the Tax column’s label. * If the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DynamicFeeName}} field on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} contains a value, it will be used instead of the Tax column label for the DocumentLink. * If the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DynamicFeeName}} field is blank, the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_DynamicFeeName}} field will not be used as the header for the Tax column. In this case, the label will be Tax. {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s and {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s will accurately reflect totals, including taxes (for exempt and non-exempt {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s), discount {{variable.Object_Code}}s, and payment processing fees. The {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} for all {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s ({{variable.Object_EventItem}}s) will be reflected on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} and in any rollups to the {{variable.Object_Event}}. {{variable.Object_LineItem}} taxes and the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}’s total {{variable.Field_Invoice_TaxAmount}} will also be visible on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}’s DocumentLink. ## Event Item Object An {{variable.Object_EventItem}} can be designated as non-taxable by using the {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxExempt}} field. {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = "Donation," will automatically be marked as {{variable.Field_EventItem_TaxExempt}} and excluded from tax calculations, whether calculated at checkout or tax-inclusive. ## Cloning Events Cloning an existing {{variable.Object_Event}} with a {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} will result in a cloned {{variable.Object_Event}} that includes the same {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} value. * If the original {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} field is blank, the cloned {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} will also be blank. * If a {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} value exists on the original {{variable.Object_Event}}, the cloned {{variable.Object_Event}} will have the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} related to it. * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} related to the {{variable.Object_Event}} that is being cloned takes priority over the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}}, including empty fields.
